# LineupBridge Business

## Product
Professional DJ booking marketplace.

## Users
Event Organizer (EO)
DJ

## Core Flow
Find DJ
→ Book
→ Negotiate
→ Agree price
→ Pay
→ Performance
→ Confirm
→ Payout
→ Complete

## Negotiation

Initial Offer
EO → DJ
DJ can:
- Accept offer
- Make counter offer
- Reject offer

Counter Offer
DJ → EO
EO can:
- Accept & Pay
- Make final offer
- Reject counter offer

Final Offer
EO → DJ
DJ can:
- Accept Final Offer
- Reject Final Offer

After Final Offer:
NEGOTIATION ENDS

DJ CANNOT make another counter offer.
